==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* First Australian to play in the [[LCS]]. 
** However, he was not the first Australian-'''born''' player, as [[Panda (James Ding)|Panda]], an American born in Australia, debuted a split before him in the [[LCS/2019 Season/Spring Season|LCS 2019 Spring Season]]. 
* His name is not, as is often assumed, a reference to the American [[wikipedia:en:Federal_Bureau_of_Investigation|Federal Bureau of Investigation]] (usually abbreviated as FBI) but a reference to an [https://www.fbigaming.com.au/ Australian internet cafe] that he spent a lot of time playing in.

=== Individual Awards ===
* LCS 1st All-Pro Team (2021 Summer)
* LCS 2nd All-Pro Team (2021 Spring)
* LCS 3rd All-Pro Team (2020 Summer, 2022 Spring, 2022 Summer)
* LCS Finals MVP (2023 Summer)
